0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000010_LYSE
0.description: Come to see how we're getting on?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000020_LYSE
1.description: We've made good progress since we took back Ala Mhigo, but there's one big issue we still have to address...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000030_LYSE
2.description: Leadership. The Domans had Lord Hien ready and willing to take the throne, but we've got no one like that here.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000040_LYSE
3.description: Theodoric was our last ruler─and he wasn't called the mad king for nothing.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000050_MNAAGO
5.description: Suffice it to say, our people have had their fill of kings─which means we need to find a new way forward.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000060_LYSE
6.description: If only it were that easy. Everyone and his uncle has an opinion.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000070_LYSE
7.description: For the time being, we're just going to have to keep leaning on General Aldynn and the Alliance for support, and see if we can't find a solution together. Something tells me we're going to be hosting a lot of meetings in the near future...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000080_LYSE
8.description: But if that's what it takes, I'm ready to talk till my jaw aches!

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000090_LYSE
9.description: The Reach is yours, Naago. Don't do anything I wouldn't.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000110_ARENVALD
11.description: Ah, there you are! I've been searching all over for you.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000120_ARENVALD
12.description: Don't worry, it's nothing bad. That said, this might not be the best place to talk. Will you join me?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000130_ARENVALD
13.description: I'll get to the point: might you be interested in a spot of adventure?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000140_ARENVALD
14.description: After all, we were “adventurers” before we were Scions, were we not?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000150_ARENVALD
15.description: After routing the imperials and liberating Ala Mhigo, I reckon we've earned a bit of respite, don't you? And what better way to spend it than by returning to our roots?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000160_ARENVALD
16.description: So what say you: shall we call on Alphinaud and go adventuring?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
18.description: Twist my arm, why don't you!

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
19.description: It's what we do, I suppose...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000220_ALPHINAUD
25.description: 'Twould appear this place is yet inhabited by King Theodoric's kin─or what is left of them. The work of terrible magicks, I fear...

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000230_ARENVALD
26.description: Terrible, aye, but their misfortune is our...fortune?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000240_ALPHINAUD
27.description: Quite... By the Twelve, there is even more than I imagined...

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000250_ARENVALD
28.description: Oh, I can't wait to see the look on Lyse's face! Thanks for believing in me, you two!

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000270_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN1
30.description: Like hells we will! We know who you've got in there!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000280_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN2
31.description: We're not leaving till you hand her over!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000290_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN3
32.description: Bring her out! Bring her out!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000320_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN1
35.description: It's true then! The bitch really is in there! I knew it! I bloody knew it!

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000330_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN1
36.description: We demand vengeance! Bring her out! Today we butcher the Butcher!

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000340_LYSE
37.description: Butcher the...? Come on, you don't mean that. We'd be no better than the imperials! If you'd all just calm down─

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000350_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN2
38.description: Calm down!? That monster and her thrice-damned Skulls dragged my man from our home and beat him to death in the street!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000360_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN3
39.description: Aye! And my dad! That bitch has spilt enough blood to fill a loch!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000370_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN1
40.description: We all know her crimes! She's a traitor and a murderer! How many of your Resistance friends have died at her hands, eh? And here you are protecting her!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000380_RAUBAHN
41.description: So that's what all the fuss is about...

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000390_RAUBAHN
42.description: Hearken to me, brothers and sisters of Ala Mhigo!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000410_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN2
44.description: That's...that's the Bull of Ala Mhigo!

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000420_RAUBAHN
45.description: My friends─you are not alone in your anger, your grief, your despair, for it is mine as well!

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000430_RAUBAHN
46.description: That gnawing pain in your breast...it is enough to bring an old bull to his knees.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000440_RAUBAHN
47.description: But I ask you, brothers and sisters, to think not only of the family and friends who were cut down before your very eyes, but to think also of the ones who were abducted─the ones who may yet live!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000450_RAUBAHN
48.description: Where were they taken? What became of them? These questions demand answers!

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000460_RAUBAHN
49.description: I share your thirst for justice. For vengeance.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000461_RAUBAHN
50.description: But we will gain only fleeting satisfaction if we give in to our base appetites─we will never know the truth!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000470_RAUBAHN
51.description: Now is the time that we, the people of Ala Mhigo, must decide what manner of nation we will build for ourselves, and for generations yet unborn.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000480_RAUBAHN
52.description: When they look to our example, will they see a people who held fast to their principles, or one who cast them aside when tried?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000490_RAUBAHN
53.description: I say to you, it is our responsibility to give these prisoners a fair trial, that they might answer to all of Ala Mhigo! The Garleans called us savages, and I'll be damned if we prove them right!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000500_ALAMHIGANCITIZEN1
54.description: I know you're right, I do, but...I can't...

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000510_FORDOLA
55.description: Well, well, well... So many visitors. Come to have a good laugh, have you?

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000520_FORDOLA
56.description: Or do you mean to put me out of my misery? To finish what you started? It's about bloody time.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000530_LYSE
57.description: That's not why we're here, no.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000540_LYSE
58.description: Do you remember what I said? How I promised you you'd live long enough to see us win our freedom? Well, I meant it. And not to mock you, either.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000560_FORDOLA
60.description: All of this is pointless. There's no reason to keep me alive, and you know it!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000570_FORDOLA
61.description: I killed your men─I killed my men! And you know what my only regret is? That I didn't kill you when I had the chance!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000580_ARENVALD
62.description: That's a lie, and you know it! You think we can't tell what you're trying to do? That we're blind?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000590_ARENVALD
63.description: You're a fool, but you're not stupid. You're ruthless. Relentless. You'd give up anything and everything to get what you want.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000600_ARENVALD
64.description: You didn't come this far, climbing over the bodies of your own brothers and sisters, just to piss it all away!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000601_ARENVALD
65.description: I see you, Fordola! I see you for what you are!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000610_FORDOLAMOTHER
66.description: Come along, Fordola! We mustn't be late! The imperial viceroy will be attending today's banquet!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000630_FORDOLA
68.description: Father, what's Lord Gaius like? Is he nice? Are you friends?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000640_FORDOLAFATHER
69.description: There you go again with all your questions...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000650_FORDOLAFATHER
70.description: Lord Gaius is a great and honorable man who looks after all of Ala Mhigo. He's very busy, and if we don't hurry, we'll miss our chance to see him.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000670_FORDOLA
72.description: Father, what did that man call us?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000680_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
73.description: The little tinhead-lover doesn't know what she is, eh? A traitor, sweetheart. A backstabbing bitch who'd gladly betray her kith and kin to gnaw on what few scraps the imperials deign to toss her. Like your bastard father and whore mother!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000690_FORDOLA
74.description: That's not true! My parents are good people! They've never done anything like that!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000700_ALAMHIGANCITIZENA
75.description: Oh but they were quick to help themselves and their bitch spawn, weren't they? You're just as guilty as them!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000750_FORDOLAMOTHER
80.description: Please! You have to do something! My husband and daughter are in danger!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000760_ALAMHIGOGARLEANOFFICER
81.description: Soldiers of the imperial army are under no obligation to intervene in the disputes of Aan.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000800_FORDOLAFATHER
85.description: It's all right, it's all right. They don't understand. But they'll see in time. They'll see that this is the only way to survive.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000820_ALAMHIGOGARLEANOFFICER
87.description: Let the savages have their fun. They'll be more compliant once they've tired themselves out.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000830_FORDOLAMOTHER
88.description: Fordola, please! You already have citizenship! Why would you want to become a soldier!?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000840_FORDOLAMOTHER
89.description: Oh gods, what have you done to your face!?

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000850_FORDOLA
90.description: Forgotten it already, have you? I'm honoring Father's memory.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000860_FORDOLAMOTHER
91.description: By telling the world that you're no better than a common savage!?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000870_FORDOLA
92.description: Am I, though, Mother? Are any of us?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000880_FORDOLA
93.description: Can't you see? Citizenship means nothing to them. If you're not a pureblood Garlean, you're no different from any other savage.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000890_FORDOLA
94.description: So I'll play the part. I'll join the legion and I'll make them respect me. And when the mob see that, they'll think twice before throwing their stones.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000910_FORDOLA
96.description: It'll be hard. Humiliating. They'll try to break us─send us crawling back to our “own kind.” But we won't, no matter what. We'll bleed for them─die for them if we have to. We'll do whatever it takes to be free!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000920_ARENVALD
97.description: So, you mean to play the part one last time, eh? The unrepentant traitor, whose death will serve to unite the people?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000940_ARENVALD
99.description: You had every chance to kill yourself. Fashion a noose from your clothes, wait for the guards to leave you alone long enough to slip it over your neck─

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000960_ARENVALD
101.description: But then it would all have been for nothing, wouldn't it? Whatever it takes. That's what you said.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000970_FORDOLA
102.description: ...Been in my head, have you? Had a little peek at my past?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000980_FORDOLA
103.description: And what, a few stolen memories tell you everything you need to know, do they?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_000990_FORDOLA
104.description: Don't you dare patronize me! You don't know a godsdamned thing about the life I've led!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001000_FORDOLA
105.description: The bastards that killed him, the bastards that let it happen─my father deserved better! I swore I'd do whatever it took to make them pay!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001021_FORDOLA
108.description: You...y-you... All that power...all that pain... It's too much... Too much for anyone!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001030_FORDOLA
109.description: The things they've done to you. The lies, the betrayal, the endless fighting...yet there you stand, unbroken. How...? Why...?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
112.description: For those I have lost. For those I can yet save.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001050_LYSE
115.description: You still have time, Fordola. Think about how you want to spend it.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001070_NANAMOULNAMO
117.description: I thank you for answering my summons in these most interesting times. You have been busy.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001080_NANAMOULNAMO
118.description: The liberation of Ala Mhigo will have far-reaching consequences, and there is a matter upon which I would seek your counsel.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001090_NANAMOULNAMO
119.description: I speak of Raubahn, and his future.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001100_NANAMOULNAMO
120.description: All know the tale of his rise from penniless refugee to member of the Syndicate, and General of the Immortal Flames... Yet though he has come to call Ul'dah home, it will never be his homeland. He is a son of Ala Mhigo.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001110_NANAMOULNAMO
121.description: And now that she is free, I thought it only a matter of time before he sought my leave to return to her. Indeed, I had resigned myself to his loss.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001120_NANAMOULNAMO
122.description: Suffice it to say, I was...greatly surprised to hear him speak so lightly of handing over the reins in Ala Mhigo, and retaking his place at my side.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001130_NANAMOULNAMO
123.description: I will welcome him with open arms, of course─he is my most trusted advisor...and my dearest friend.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001140_NANAMOULNAMO
124.description: But I have known the man a long time, and beneath that steely gaze, I spied a flicker of doubt.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001150_NANAMOULNAMO
125.description: Whether Raubahn chooses to remain in Ul'dah or return to Ala Mhigo, I only wish that he do so with a heart unburdened by guilt or regret.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001160_NANAMOULNAMO
126.description: Yet how can he freely make such a choice knowing how much I depend on him?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001170_NANAMOULNAMO
127.description: It is past time that I learned to discharge my duties as a sultana alone. I must go forth and see my realm with my own eyes, and hear the wind with my own ears.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001180_NANAMOULNAMO
128.description: Might I have your company for a brief adventure?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001191_NANAMOULNAMO
130.description: Allow me a moment to change into something a touch less conspicuous, and I will join you outside.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001200_NANAMOSTEWARD
140.description: Your Grace, you mustn't! The danger is too great!

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001210_NANAMOSTEWARD
141.description: Please, Your Grace, come back! I beg of you!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001220_NANAMOULNAMO
142.description: It seems you're the one who needs looking after, Marcechamp!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001240_RAUBAHN
145.description: I have kept the promise made.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001250_NANAMOULNAMO
146.description: So you have. And, in turn, so too shall I keep mine.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001260_NANAMOULNAMO
147.description: With your winnings, you have become one of the six most wealthy souls in all Ul'dah. And so, as tradition dictates, Raubahn Aldynn...

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001270_NANAMOULNAMO
148.description: ...You have earned yourself a seat on the Syndicate! May your new station garner you still greater glories!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001280_RAUBAHN
149.description: I am honored, Your Grace, and vow to serve with every fiber of my being, from this day till my last.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001290_RAUBAHN
150.description: Long live the sultana! And long live Ul'dah!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001300_LOLORITO
151.description: A personal summons from the Scions─this must be important business indeed. Though if it concerns anything so underhand as an assassination, I fear I can be of little help.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001330_LOLORITO
154.description: 'Tis indeed unsettling to find oneself seated across from an impassive mask.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001340_LOLORITO
155.description: There. Would this better please Your Grace? Or should I address you as “Lady Lilira,” hmm?

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001350_NANAMOULNAMO
156.description: Nay, the deception has served its purpose. I am glad to see you found amusement in my little jest, Lord Lolorito, but shall we proceed to the business at hand?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001360_LOLORITO
157.description: By all means. I must say, I am most eager to hear your proposal.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001370_NANAMOULNAMO
158.description: Simply put, I would aid the refugees camped in Thanalan in their efforts to return to Ala Mhigo.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001380_NANAMOULNAMO
159.description: The reparations you paid in the wake of your earlier misdemeanors will be used to fund the endeavor─together with the fortune seized from the late Teledji Adeledji's estate.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001390_NANAMOULNAMO
160.description: But this plan is not intended to benefit the displaced alone. I would make of this an investment which shall enrich Ul'dah and Ala Mhigo both.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001400_NANAMOULNAMO
161.description: And who better to consult on matters of profit than the wealthiest man in all of Thanalan? I beseech you, then, Lord Lolorito...share with us your mercantile wisdom.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001410_LOLORITO
162.description: Ah heh heh... 'Twould seem Your Grace has matured beyond acts of earnest yet misplaced charity. Pray tell me more...

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001420_LOLORITO
163.description: To summarize: in return for facilitating the repatriation of refugees, and assisting in the establishment of new industry in Ala Mhigo, you ask that a proportion of all subsequent profits be promised to Ul'dah.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001430_LOLORITO
164.description: I am impressed, Your Grace. 'Tis an elegant solution─albeit one lacking certain crucial details, specifically which industry and where.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001440_NANAMOULNAMO
165.description: How swiftly you identify the weakness in my plan, just as I knew you would.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001450_NANAMOULNAMO
166.description: Your travels have taken you across the length and breadth of Gyr Abania, and you know the land far better than I.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001460_NANAMOULNAMO
167.description: Which of the settlements you visited would best provide a home for our refugees? Which has the greatest potential to flourish, given the appropriate investment?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
180.description: Clearly you want me to say “the Saltery.”

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001470_LOLORITO
181.description: Yes, a quarry town certainly does carry the potential for profit─at least, it would do, were it situated anywhere near a lucrative market. It would cost more to transport the materials than they are worth. In my humble opinion.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001480_LOLORITO
182.description: Yes, if a stable trade route can be established between Ul'dah and Ala Mhigo, then Ala Ghiri would once more become an important waypoint. But while such growth would greatly benefit its current residents, I am afraid it could sustain little beyond that...

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001490_LOLORITO
183.description: Ah, yes─that desolate little village on the shore of Loch Seld.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001500_LOLORITO
184.description: I know the Saltery and its products well. The imperial invasion brought an end to their more widespread distribution, much to the dismay of many a wealthy gourmand. Myself included.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001510_LOLORITO
185.description: Salt has ever been a transformative ingredient. And in this instance, I daresay it could transform a modicum of effort into a mountain of gil.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001520_NANAMOULNAMO
186.description: The local citizens will need to be consulted, of course, but I trust the East Aldenard Trading Company can be relied upon to provide its assistance in negotiating a mutually beneficial arrangement.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001530_LOLORITO
187.description: Naturally, Your Grace. I shall dispatch representatives well versed in the extraction of this “white gold,” and wring every last onze of profit from its production.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001540_LOLORITO
188.description: The loch's bounty will contribute to Ala Mhigo's enrichment, whilst easing the burden on the Bull's aching shoulders─just as Your Grace desired.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001570_RAUBAHN
191.description: People are screaming for the Butcher's blood again. No sooner have we broken up one mob than another forms. Thankfully, all have been amenable to reason...thus far.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001580_RAUBAHN
192.description: But it is no concern of yours.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001590_RAUBAHN
193.description: We must speak of the men Arenvald and his comrades apprehended in the Peaks.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001600_PIPIN
194.description: By their uniforms, the captives were first judged to be imperial troops...but after further investigation, their true identities came to light.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001610_PIPIN
195.description: I daresay you remember Yuyuhase and Laurentius─the fugitives who conspired with Captain Ilberd in the Crystal Braves' betrayal.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001620_PIPIN
196.description: Aye, well...it would seem they followed him all the way to the Wall. It was they who orchestrated the slaughter of the Resistance fighters prior to the Griffin's infernal ritual.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001630_RAUBAHN
197.description: Were it in your hands, how would you punish these men?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001640_RAUBAHN
201.description: Hear, hear. There is no more fitting sentence for the perpetrators of such a massacre. And that is but one of their crimes.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001650_RAUBAHN
202.description: You would spare these animals? Yours is a more merciful brand of justice than mine.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001660_RAUBAHN
203.description: In any event, I thank you for your honesty. When the time comes for the Alliance to pass judgment, I'll see that your opinion is heard.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001670_RAUBAHN
204.description: Well, that concludes our business here, but there is more I would say. Walk with me.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001680_RAUBAHN
205.description: I bear a share of the blame for Ilberd's atrocities. Had I openly supported the cause of Ala Mhigan liberation, he might not have felt driven to do what he did...

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001690_RAUBAHN
206.description: Things could have been different, and I'm sorry they aren't.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001700_RAUBAHN
207.description: But even after all that has happened, my homeland is free. With the Scions and the Alliance at their side, my countrymen have reclaimed what many thought lost forever.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001710_RAUBAHN
208.description: Under her new leadership, I have every confidence that Ala Mhigo will emerge from the shadow of the Empire and rise once more to greatness.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001720_RAUBAHN
209.description: Which means my work here is done. Soon, I will return to Ul'dah, and take my place at the sultana's side.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001740_RAUBAHN
211.description: I'll not deny there's a part of me that wants to stay...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001750_RAUBAHN
212.description: The same part that contemplated renouncing my rank and joining you as a wandering sellsword.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001760_RAUBAHN
213.description: But I pledged my blade to Nanamo. And I will not betray that oath.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001770_PIPIN
214.description: Is this truly what you want, Father?

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001780_RAUBAHN
215.description: It is. Ever has my sword been hers to command, and ever shall it remain.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001790_RAUBAHN
216.description: Thank you for lending an ear. When all the rest are clamoring for me to stay, I trust you'll send me on my way.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001801_LYSE
218.description: I am Lyse Hext, and I speak for the Resistance.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001810_LYSE
219.description: Among you are village elders, refugee leaders; envoys from the Ananta and the Qiqirn.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001820_LYSE
220.description: You've come from every corner of Gyr Abania to help decide the future of Ala Mhigo. But before that, I want to ask you a question.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001830_LYSE
221.description: What was the first thing you noticed when you came in?

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001831_LYSE
222.description: For me, it was that empty throne.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001840_LYSE
223.description: It has no one to sit on it now. No viceroy. No king.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001850_LYSE
224.description: Would any of you like to take their place?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001860_LYSE
225.description: Or should someone else sit there?

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001870_LYSE
226.description: Then let's sit here, in a circle. As equals. And, I hope, as friends.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001880_ALPHINAUD
227.description: Expertly done. Lyse has removed monarchy as a choice early in the game, and positioned them to consider a joint government.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001890_ALPHINAUD
228.description: All things considered, I would say events have got off to a fine start...

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001900_RAGANFRID
229.description: ...and that is Ala Gannha's stance on the matter.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001910_LYSE
230.description: Thank you, Raganfrid. Another vote in favor. Next, let's hear from Shanti of the Qalyana. Tell us, how do your people feel about the idea of a republic...?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001920_QALYANAPATRIARCH
231.description: The Ananta wish only that those who dwell within Gyr Abania devote themssselves to our faith...

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001930_QALYANAPATRIARCH
232.description: You shall all worship Sri Lakshmi!

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001940_QALYANAPATRIARCH
233.description: Lady of Bliss! Grace usss once more with your beauteousss visage!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001950_LYSE
234.description: This can't be happening... No crystals were allowed through the door!

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001960_ALPHINAUD
235.description: We can worry about the how of it later! We need to evacuate these people right now, or the primal will make thralls of them all!

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_001990_RAUBAHN
238.description: Godsdammit! The guards were already turned!

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002010_RAUBAHN
241.description: The Qalyana would see us all enthralled.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002020_LYSE
242.description: Then they're going to be sorely disappointed. We have the Warrior of Light and Arenvald to shield us.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002030_RAUBAHN
243.description: Aye, but they can't well defend your guests and attack the primal, can they? We're stuck on the back foot.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002040_LYSE
244.description: Uh... All right. I think I have an idea. Keep these people safe, General! I'll be back as soon as I can!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002050_RAUBAHN
245.description: Bah! Whatever she's about, she'd best make it quick!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002060_RAUBAHN
246.description: Come, then! Who will be next to die on my steel!?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002070_ARENVALD
247.description: Damn it all... It's only a matter of time before we miss one...

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002090_FORDOLA
249.description: What of it? Do you want to kill this thing or not?

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002101_ARENVALD
251.description: We...we did it! We beat her!

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002120_LYSE
253.description: ...I'm only going to say this once.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002130_LYSE
254.description: The Ananta just summoned their primal in the throne room. My friends are fighting her, but they need help.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002140_LYSE
255.description: They need someone with the Echo, and by the gods, I wish I had it. But I don't.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002150_LYSE
256.description: I told you before that you still had time, but things have changed. I need your answer now.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002160_LYSE
257.description: You can end it like Zenos...or you can fight for Ala Mhigo. Your choice.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002180_FORDOLA
259.description: It's done. Take me back to my cell.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002200_RAGANFRID
261.description: Not you. You I will never forgive.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002220_RAGANFRID
263.description: For standing against a primal and saving us from servitude─you have my thanks.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002230_RAUBAHN
264.description: A fine spot to contemplate the heavens...

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002240_RAUBAHN
265.description: The meeting is over. The envoys have chosen to instate a government modeled on Ishgard's House of Commons─a ruling body of representatives elected by the people.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002250_RAUBAHN
266.description: 'Tis a fair decision, and one which signals the end of my part in all this. But I would gaze upon Gyr Abania's stars one last time before I leave...

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002270_RAUBAHN
268.description: Your Grace!? I─ There was no word...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002280_NANAMOULNAMO
269.description: Raubahn Aldynn. You are hereby dismissed as General of the Immortal Flames, and relieved of your seat on the Syndicate.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002300_NANAMOULNAMO
271.description: Raubahn, I am no longer a child.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002301_NANAMOULNAMO
272.description: Stay here, in your homeland. Work with your brethren. Rebuild Ala Mhigo!

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002310_RAUBAHN
273.description: You desire to stand alone─I understand. But remember what happened...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002320_NANAMOULNAMO
274.description: I remember full well the consequences of my naivety! And thus did I consult at length with a most trusted advisor ere I embarked upon this course!

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002330_RAUBAHN
275.description: A most trusted advisor!? And what of me? Am I no longer deserving of your confidence?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002340_NANAMOULNAMO
276.description: What trust can there be between us when you withhold the truth from me!?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002350_NANAMOULNAMO
277.description: Did you think me oblivious to the anguish in your eyes when you spoke of returning to Ul'dah!?

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002360_NANAMOULNAMO
278.description: For years and years, we have trusted one another, yet now you refuse to confess your heart's desire!?

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002370_RAUBAHN
279.description: I swore an oath to you that day on the sands. I pledged my sword─

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002380_NANAMOULNAMO
280.description: And it has served me well. But in Pipin you have forged a new sword, as sharp and deadly as the blade you bequeathed him.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002390_NANAMOULNAMO
281.description: I will show you a sultana who can wield every weapon at her disposal─including Lolorito and his Monetarist cronies!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002400_NANAMOULNAMO
282.description: So follow your heart...please. You are home. You are free.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002420_NANAMOULNAMO
284.description: Smile for me, Raubahn. I would have this parting be a joyous one.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002430_RAUBAHN
285.description: Thank you, Your Grace. It has been an honor to serve you and Ul'dah.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002440_NANAMOULNAMO
286.description: Tomorrow you will serve Ala Mhigo, and fight for the good of all Eorzea. Am I understood?

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002460_LYSE
288.description: Thanks for shielding us from Lakshmi, you two. If you hadn't been there, the rest of us would be worshipping her by now.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002470_ARENVALD
289.description: You're kind to include me, Lyse, but we both know who did most of the work. I could scarce keep track of the battle, let alone land a telling blow.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002480_ARENVALD
290.description: No shame in admitting it. The Warrior of Light has put far better men than me in the shade.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002490_ALPHINAUD
291.description: Ahem. Did I mention that I encountered the sultana in the palace? It would seem Her Grace has come to Gyr Abania to oversee the final stages of her relocation project.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002500_ALPHINAUD
292.description: She was in search of General Aldynn, and I directed her to the rooftop garden. I do hope he was still there...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002510_NANAMOULNAMO
293.description: Are you in the habit of gossiping about the affairs of royalty, Master Leveilleur?

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002520_ALPHINAUD
294.description: Certainly not, Your Grace! I was merely informing my companions─

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002530_NANAMOULNAMO
295.description: Be at ease, Alphinaud. 'Twas only a jest.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002540_NANAMOULNAMO
296.description: But I must yield the floor to Raubahn. He has an important announcement to make.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002551_RAUBAHN
298.description: As of yesternight, I have been relieved of my post in the Immortal Flames and the Syndicate both...

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002560_PIPIN
299.description: ...I shall be assuming my father's duties. And may I say that Tizona has never felt heavier upon my back.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002570_RAUBAHN
300.description: 'Twould seem I am in need of employment. Mayhap one of my old acquaintances can introduce me to a mercenary company or some such...

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002580_PIPIN
301.description: You may be getting on in years, Father, but you'd struggle to find a band of sellswords who wouldn't snap your hand off─your...remaining hand.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002591_NANAMOULNAMO
303.description: Yes, the Bull of Ala Mhigo need not be put out to pasture just yet...

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002592_NANAMOULNAMO
304.description: [UNABLE TO CONTAIN HERSELF, BURSTS INTO LAUGHTER]

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002600_RAUBAHN
305.description: Your Grace has developed a wicked edge to her humor. And you, Pipin, would do well not to laugh when the future may hold the same for you!

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002620_RAUBAHN
307.description: Aye. That seems to be the way of it. I would be glad to aid you in rebuilding our nation. If you'll have me.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002640_ALPHINAUD
309.description: Well, that was unexpected...though you seem distinctly unsurprised.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002650_ALPHINAUD
310.description: Either you are more astute than I give you credit for...or I am losing my touch.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04100_002660_ALPHINAUD
311.description: In any event, one thing is certain: Ala Mhigo will rejoice at the homecoming of her dearest son.
